assumptions: Analysis is closed-form only: no SPICE, no measurement, and no modification to the project, files, or schematic; every result is derived from the declared prior-stage component specifications plus the stated requirement IDs.
+3V3 is taken as 3.3 V nominal with a +/-5% distribution tolerance (3.135-3.465 V) per PWR-002; VBUS is taken as USB 5 V nominal with the USB 2.0 range 4.75-5.25 V per PWR-001.
Board current budget is 500 mA peak on the 3V3 rail, taken from the ESP32-WROOM-32E requirement for a >= 500 mA supply (PWR-003); TMP102 adds 10 uA typical.

Tests covering the proposed-but-unplaceable parts (AP2112K-3.3 LDO, 4.7 kOhm I2C pull-ups, 10 kOhm EN pull-up) are value/rating checks on the selected part numbers, valid for the next revision; the MVP no-new-footprint rule (MECH-006) means these parts are not physically present, and the as-built rail-source test is therefore reported unverified rather than pass.

The USB-input-current test assumes the proposed linear LDO topology and a default USB 2.0 high-power port (500 mA); it is reported failed because a linear 500 mA 3V3 budget leaves zero margin against the port limit. A switching converter, a reduced budget, or USB-C/BC1.2 current negotiation resolves it.
LED and resistive-divider checks are reported unverified because no such branches exist anywhere in the netlist, pin table, or component list - there is nothing to analyze, not a missing calculation.

The AP2112 thermal check is unverified solely because no theta_JA or package power-dissipation figure was supplied in the declared prior-stage specifications; the 0.85 W dissipation figure itself is computed and stated.

I2C timing (rise time / bus capacitance with 4.7 kOhm at 400 kHz) is outside the assigned closed-form scope of power, regulator, LED, divider, pull-up, and rating-margin analysis and is not claimed here; only the DC pull-up current and derating are evaluated.
ESP32 digital I/O thresholds are the datasheet ratiometric values (VIH 0.75 x VDD / VIL 0.25 x VDD, VOH min 0.8 x VDD) at VDD = 3.3 V.
Net-level electrical correctness (ERC/DRC counts, missing decoupling, single-pin VBUS net) is inherited as documented upstream limitations and is not re-verified as a simulation test.
models: Rail tolerance model: V_rail_wc = V_nom x (1 +/- 0.05), compared against datasheet recommended-operating min/max supply limits.
LDO headroom model: V_in_min_required = V_out + V_dropout, evaluated at the USB VBUS minimum of 4.75 V.
Linear-regulator current model: I_in = I_out + I_q (a linear LDO passes load current 1:1 from input to output).
Current-margin model: margin_percent = (I_available - I_required) / I_required x 100.
Ohm's-law pull-up model: I_pullup = (V_rail - V_OL) / R_pullup, compared against the guaranteed open-drain sink current.
Resistor derating model: P = V^2 / R, with the equivalent allowed current at the rail expressed as I_allowed = P_rated / V_rail for margin arithmetic.
CMOS/I2C DC logic-level model: VOH_driver >= VIH_receiver and VOL_driver <= VIL_receiver, using the ratiometric thresholds (0.7 x V+ / 0.3 x V+ for TMP102, 0.8 x VDD / 0.25 x VDD for ESP32).
LDO dissipation model: P_diss = (V_in - V_out) x I_out (computed, but not convertible to a thermal verdict without a theta_JA figure).

tests.name: +3V3 rail nominal vs ESP32-WROOM-32E recommended supply range (3.0-3.6 V)
tests.source: PWR-002; Espressif ESP32-WROOM-32E datasheet Section 5.2 Recommended Operating Conditions (VDD 3.0/3.3/3.6 V). Expected window 3.0 V to 3.6 V.

tests.name: +3V3 rail worst-case high (+5% tolerance) vs TMP102 and ESP32 max supply (3.6 V)
tests.source: PWR-002; TI TMP102 datasheet SBOS397 Section 7.3 (V+ max 3.6 V) and ESP32-WROOM-32E datasheet Section 5.2 (VDD max 3.6 V). Expected limit <= 3.6 V; margin 0.135 V (3.9%).

tests.name: +3V3 rail worst-case low (-5% tolerance) vs ESP32 min 3.0 V / TMP102 min 1.4 V
tests.source: PWR-002; ESP32-WROOM-32E datasheet Section 5.2 (VDD min 3.0 V), TMP102 SBOS397 Section 7.3 (V+ min 1.4 V). Expected limit >= 3.0 V; margin 0.135 V (4.5%).

tests.name: VBUS 5 V input rail vs AP2112K-3.3 input range (2.5-6.0 V) and USB 2.0 tolerance (4.75-5.25 V)
tests.source: PWR-001; Diodes Inc. AP2112 datasheet Electrical Characteristics / Absolute Maximum Ratings (VIN 2.5-6.0 V). Worst-case 5.25 V is 0.75 V below the 6.0 V input maximum.

tests.source: PWR-002/PWR-006; Diodes Inc. AP2112 datasheet Electrical Characteristics (VOUT 3.3 V, +/-1.5%). Entirely inside the 3.135-3.465 V rail window.

tests.measured_v: 4.50 V minimum input required (4.75 V available; 1.20 V headroom)
tests.name: AP2112K-3.3 dropout headroom at 500 mA load from VBUS minimum 4.75 V
tests.source: PWR-001/PWR-002; Diodes Inc. AP2112 datasheet Electrical Characteristics (dropout 250 mV typ at 600 mA). 3.3 V + 0.25 V = 3.55 V required minimum input, satisfied with >= 1.2 V of headroom at the USB minimum of 4.75 V.

+3V3 rail current budget vs AP2112K-3.3 output capability (proposed U3)
tests.source: PWR-003; Diodes Inc. AP2112 datasheet Features / Electrical Characteristics (IOUT max 600 mA) vs the 500 mA board budget required by ESP32-WROOM-32E datasheet Section 5.2.

tests.name: +3V3 typical load sum (U1 Wi-Fi active 80 mA + U2 quiescent 0.01 mA) vs AP2112K-3.3 600 mA
tests.source: PWR-003; ESP32-WROOM-32E datasheet Section 5.4 Current Consumption (80 mA typ, Wi-Fi active), TMP102 SBOS397 Section 7.5 (10 uA quiescent), AP2112 datasheet (600 mA max).

tests.name: J1 micro-B VBUS contact current rating vs 500 mA peak board draw
tests.source: PWR-001/PWR-003; Amphenol ICC 10118194-0001LF product drawing Electrical characteristics table (1.8 A per power contact).

tests.name: 5 V input current vs USB 2.0 high-power port limit (linear LDO, 1:1 input/output current)
tests.source: PWR-003; USB 2.0 Specification Section 7.2.1 (high-power bus-powered function limited to 5 unit loads = 500 mA). A linear AP2112 LDO passes load current 1:1, so a 500 mA 3V3 budget draws ~500 mA (plus 55 uA quiescent) from VBUS, leaving no margin against the port limit; either a switching converter, a lower current budget, or USB-C/BC1.2 negotiation for >500 mA is required.

tests.name: I2C pull-up current through 4.7 kOhm vs minimum open-drain sink capability at VOL = 0.4 V
tests.source: IF-003; NXP UM10204 I2C-bus Specification Rev. 6 Section 6.1 (IOL min 3 mA at VOL = 0.4 V for standard/fast mode). I_pullup = (3.3 V - 0.4 V) / 4.7 kOhm = 0.617 mA per line, well below the guaranteed sink current.

tests.name: R1/R2 4.7 kOhm pull-up power derating vs 0603 rated power (expressed as equivalent current at 3.3 V)
tests.source: IF-003; Yageo RC-L series datasheet Electrical characteristics table, RC0603 row (0.1 W rated). Worst-case dissipation = 3.3 V^2 / 4.7 kOhm = 2.32 mW = 2.3% of rating; equivalent allowed current at 3.3 V is 0.1 W / 3.3 V = 30.3 mA.

tests.name: R3 10 kOhm EN pull-up current and dissipation vs 0603 rating (expressed as equivalent current at 3.3 V)
tests.source: PWR-008; Yageo RC-L series datasheet Electrical characteristics table, RC0603 row (0.1 W rated). I = 3.3 V / 10 kOhm = 0.33 mA, P = 1.09 mW = 1.1% of rating (value analysis only; part not placeable in the MVP).

tests.margin_percent: unverified - no junction-to-ambient thermal resistance or power-dissipation rating for the SOT-23-5 AP2112 package is present in the declared prior-stage specifications, so allowable dissipation at the +85 degC ambient of TEMP-001 cannot be computed in closed form
tests.name: AP2112K-3.3 LDO thermal dissipation margin at 500 mA from 5 V
tests.required_ma: n/a - dissipation is 0.85 W ((5.0 V - 3.3 V) x 0.5 A), not a current quantity

tests.source: PWR-003; TI TMP102 datasheet SBOS397 Section 7.5 Electrical Characteristics (10 uA typical quiescent, serial bus inactive) against the AP2112K-3.3 600 mA capability.
